Km_epithelial_uM.comment: Km ~160 uM for [3H]KPV uptake via hPepT1 in Caco2-BBE intestinal epithelial cells. Dalmasso 2008 (Gastroenterology, PMID 18061177, DOI 10.1053/j.gastro.2007.10.026), Fig 4C.

Km_immune_uM.comment: Km ~700 uM for [3H]KPV uptake via hPepT1 in Jurkat human T cells. Dalmasso 2008 Fig 5F. Immune-cell PepT1 has ~4x higher Km (lower affinity) than epithelial. This is the closest available immune-cell KPV/PepT1 kinetic anchor; synovial macrophages are NOT characterized.

Km_used_uM.comment: Model uses the IMMUNE-cell Km (700 uM) as the central value because the relevant healthy comparator is a joint macrophage, not an enterocyte. Sensitivity spans 160-1000 uM.

pept1_kpv_kinetics.Vmax_note: Dalmasso 2008 reports Km but not an absolute Vmax convertible to intracellular accumulation ceiling in a synovial macrophage. The healthy-cell accumulation is therefore parameterized by a dimensionless PepT1 expression scenario (see pept1_expression_scenarios) rather than a raw Vmax. THIS IS THE HEADLINE UNCERTAINTY.

pept1_macrophage_expression.status: QUALITATIVELY DEMONSTRATED, QUANTITATIVELY UNCHARACTERIZED IN SYNOVIAL MACROPHAGES
pept1_macrophage_expression.evidence_for: Dalmasso 2008 (PMID 18061177): 'KPV acts via hPepT1 expressed in immune and intestinal epithelial cells'; functional PepT1-mediated [3H]KPV uptake shown in Jurkat T cells. Viennois 2016 (PMID 27458604) and KPV-nanoparticle colitis papers (PMID 39211778, 31408067) repeatedly state KPV targets macrophages via PepT1 overexpressed on inflamed-tissue macrophages.
pept1_macrophage_expression.gap: NO study quantifies PepT1 (SLC15A1) protein/functional expression in SYNOVIAL-JOINT macrophages, resting or MSU-activated. Whether a healthy (non-pyroptotic) synovial macrophage already admits KPV via PepT1 -- and how much -- is unknown. This single unknown gates the entire selectivity (A2) question.

pept1_expression_scenarios.comment: Healthy-cell KPV accumulation modeled as a linear-regime accumulation ratio AR_lin = C_in,healthy/C_ext (dimensionless) valid when C_ext << Km, from which the saturating ceiling C_in_max_healthy = AR_lin * Km is derived. Selectivity S = C_in,pyroptotic / C_in,healthy. Four scenarios span the unknown.

absent.meaning: synovial macrophages express no functional PepT1; healthy cells exclude KPV -> pore confers full selectivity

low.meaning: low PepT1; healthy cells admit modest KPV

moderate.meaning: PepT1 equilibrates KPV (net non-concentrative) -> pore adds ~no selectivity in linear regime

high.meaning: concentrative proton-coupled PepT1; healthy cells accumulate ABOVE extracellular -> pore selectivity < 1 (anti-selective) in linear regime

kpv_intracellular_ic50.comment: Effective anti-inflammatory concentration of KPV. Dalmasso 2008 (PMID 18061177): 'Nanomolar concentrations of KPV inhibit the activation of NF-kappaB'; the lowest experimentally effective concentration was 10 nM KPV (co-incubation with IL-1beta significantly reduced NF-kB luciferase in Caco2-BBE). This is an EXTRACELLULAR effective concentration in a PepT1-expressing cell -> it already convolves transport + intracellular potency, so it is a conservative (if anything low) proxy for the intracellular concentration needed. Range 1-100 nM covers the nanomolar band and less-sensitive cell contexts. NOTE: because this IC50 is so low, the flux-sufficiency (A1) bar is trivially cleared by any route that reaches even nanomolar synovial [KPV] -- which sharpens the fact that SELECTIVITY, not flux, is the real decision variable.
